captions.detailed: A classic pedestal-style gumball vending machine featuring a spherical transparent glass bowl mounted on top of a red-painted cast lower mechanism housing and tall stand. The top of the bowl is capped with a grey refill lid that rotates on a rear horizontal hinge, while the lower red base includes a black coin/dispensing knob rotating continuously about a horizontal shaft and a small hinged grey door flap at the bottom chute.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a pedestal gumball machine. The model must feature a tall red pedestal base, a spherical clear bowl, a grey hinged refill lid at the top, a rotatable black dispensing knob on the side, and a hinged flap door on the front chute.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining several parts and their joints. It builds a base link representing the red pedestal stand and the lower mechanism housing. A spherical glass bowl is attached on top of the base. The grey refill lid is defined with a revolute joint rotating on a rear horizontal axis at the crown of the bowl. A black dispensing knob is mounted via a continuous joint on a horizontal shaft through the housing. Finally, a small dispensing chute flap is attached near the bottom using a revolute joint.
